prompts.title: 概念图 1 · 镜海群岛：整体世界
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-end environment concept art for the same original immersive knowledge exploration game, Wanderwise. Produce ONE full-bleed cinematic 16:9 landscape image, highly detailed physically plausible materials and painterly cinematic lighting, premium fantasy environmental storytelling, adult sophisticated inviting atmosphere. Shared art direction: a warm lived-in timber-and-cream-plaster scholar's cottage with brass fixtures, emerald accents, linen, aged books, clear glass, ivy and a mature star tree; situated on handcrafted pearl-limestone and wood terraces among still turquoise mirror-water, lavender and apricot luminous gardens. Exterior geology is smooth pearlescent stone with botanical cover, never bare brown dirt hills or a realistic dry alpine valley. Fantasy is expressed through rich spatial depth, violet-canopy trees, rose-copper twilight, faint aqua bioluminescent shoreline, drifting petals and golden fireflies. Colors vivid but considered, clear warm focal lighting and cool atmospheric depths, dark readable resting areas, no neon cyberpunk, no amusement park, no cartoon low-poly, no huge hologram dashboard, no sea of identical floating cards. Human-scale navigable architecture, tangible hand-crafted objects, believable walking routes and return paths. No watermark or logos. Text only if specifically requested below, and accurately rendered in elegant small Chinese lettering. Do not include additional panels or collage. This is a proposed visual concept, not a screenshot of existing software.
Primary request: a magnificent coherent overview of a magical home and its surrounding knowledge landscape, a NEW design in which the cottage is NOT on a dirt hill.
Composition: oblique environmental establishing shot from about 15 metres above a nearby flower-lined walkway, 28mm lens, intimate richly detailed cottage foreground left-of-center occupying ~35% width, landscape expanding toward the right and distance. The house has recognizable half-timber cream plaster walls, dark steep gable roof over the main reading room, large amber illuminated windows and a front door at ground level on a flat pearl-stone landing. An adjacent lower timber wing supports a beautiful roof observatory deck and mature twisting tree with suspended small glass-star lanterns; an obvious stair and balcony connect it to the cottage. A slender sculpted bronze-vine circular galaxy gate glows on this roof deck, small enough not to dominate.
The cottage rests on broad level limestone terraces on the edge of a luminous still lake, terraces covered in delicate moss and gardens, no exposed earth slopes or floating chunks of raw rock. Three distinct walkable paths leave its front landing: a curving wood bridge into luminous violet and emerald woodland; a pale stepping causeway to a quiet mirrored lake pavilion; and a distant rose-gold boulevard aligned toward the sunset. Beyond them smooth lavender mountain ranges with terrace trails descend to a turquoise sea and botanical islands. Waterfalls and mist join land and water elegantly. Small distant hanging islands may appear in sky but no shattered ground. Great translucent aurora arc in a dusky indigo sky, pinprick stars only at upper edge. Exterior sunset remains compatible with warm cottage and roof lighting. Forest, mountains, lake, sea each have distinct silhouettes and use the same timber-brass botanical design language. Image only, no labels or text, no characters. Emphasize that the exterior feels as finely crafted and magical as the beloved roof garden.

Primary request: the interior of the SAME fantasy scholar's cottage redesigned as the player's deeply personal interest library and idea workshop.
Composition: a human eye-level 26mm interior view from near the front door, one coherent open room with dark exposed timber rafters, cream textured plaster, rich wooden plank floor, large glazed opening at rear right onto an emerald-turquoise mirror lake and violet flowering trees. Warm walnut shelves at left have a curated small collection of books and framed bookmarked article fragments rather than thousands of books; handwritten annotations and tactile bookmark tabs. One elegant freestanding wall display blends pressed botanicals, a few meaningful interest constellations, photographs and the owner's unfinished notes, like a personal evolving curiosity map, not a psychological diagnosis or holographic data display. An armchair with moss-green cushion and cream linen blanket sits in a quiet reading nook.
Foreground center-left: a substantial circular green inlaid wood-and-brass synthesis table, matching the existing cottage's broad round green tabletop. Two actual open annotated notebooks and a pair of small glass source-crystal holders on the table, their amber and cool-blue light gently connecting above a central sheet bearing a new sketch/idea, no giant magical pyramid. A central brass rotary dial and a book full of provenance ribbons, visible handmade scientific/poetic apparatus. Low cabinet with drawers for personal collected articles and a little tray holding recent updates. A discreet vintage muted-red telephone niche far right as a future connection to people, never dominates.
No giant menu UI. Only three small tasteful physical labels near their corresponding objects, exact Chinese: '我的收藏', '兴趣画布', '思维合成'. One person's private restful space, not a public library or large tavern. Warm fine tactile materials and tiny magical light details.

Primary request: the SAME roof star-tree garden observatory transformed into a beautiful interface between the owner's private self and the outside world; detailed thought cocktail bar and an inviting gateway preview.
Composition: human eye-level 24mm wide view across the roof deck. Match the beloved rich garden reference language: monumental twisting tree center-left, huge natural leafy canopy, glass star baubles hanging at different heights, warm winding brass/vine accents on bark, deep flower beds with pale blue luminous flowers, many small amber lanterns, curved wooden bench around planted root-bed and linen cushions. Directly above the coupe a delicate miniature sunset boulevard appears inside a transparent swirling lens, architectural detail visible, like a tangible place you could enter. It is architecturally distinct from the slender circular spiral GALAXY gate farther back on the deck, so knowledge galaxy and cocktail journey are not confused. The galaxy gate shows luminous cream/blue spiral stars. Small separate wooden door at far right bears label '返回小屋'. At the edge of the deck, a brass telescope points outward and a single small letterbox with two sealed luminous envelopes implies received replies; no crowd, no surveillance imagery.
Below and beyond the railing see the SAME mirror-water botanical archipelago, violet forests and distant lavender mountains, not a dry ordinary mountain photograph. Golden side lighting from lamps, cooling lavender twilight, elegant dreamlike opulence, no giant text overlays.

Primary request: show the actual explorable Sunset Boulevard created from romantic literature + photography, a coherent first-person journey rather than a card result or drink advertisement.
Composition: first-person human eye-level 24mm view down a gently curving long intimate pedestrian boulevard over rose-tinted mirror-water, sunset precisely at distant vanishing point, apricot cloud banks and plum-blue shadow sky. The near avenue has polished warm stone with fine brass inlaid lines and subtle reflections, organic ornamental bronze railings over water, lush violet/coral trees and glowing amber lamps, arcade openings and plant-filled balconies on each side. Left buildings are charming timber literary ateliers with a real hanging page scroll, open book in one recessed display and one small brass-framed text stand; right buildings are beautiful photographic studios with elegant framed sunset photographs, a real vintage camera behind glass and one discreet contact sheet. These must look like richly staged explorable galleries, not shop advertisements or two endless feeds.
A small central bridge links the two sides at the first street junction. Thematically pair a warm illuminated passage about memory/absence in left gallery and a cinematic empty-chair sunset photograph in right gallery. Middle distance another two storytelling stops lead to a quiet final creation pavilion by the water. Five clear visual landmarks maximum, spacious walking surface, meaningful composition. In near foreground left an elegant small physical street sign reads exactly '落日大道'; below in smaller text '文学 × 摄影'. At the first junction a single floating but restrained warm glass prompt ~18% width, exact readable Chinese: '同一束光，怎样成为一个故事？' and below smaller '阅读 · 观察 · 创作'. Do not invent authors or fake article quotations. An unobtrusive small brass sign beside the entrance arch behind/right reads '返回观星台', indicating stable exit. Atmospheric gold dust like tiny film grain, rose-gold sun rays and subtle drifting paper/petals, richly saturated and magical, no cars, no modern billboards, no people, no giant abstract portal dominating the avenue.

A small stone inlay between the alcoves reads '同一个问题，不同的回答'.
Across the lake, distant smooth lavender and pearl mountains with a readable switchback trail and a few resting terraces suggest a progressive learning journey; beyond the ridge a gap opens onto turquoise sea and luminous distant botanical islands suggesting unfamiliar topics. A recognizable tiny warm timber cottage and its roof star tree stand across the water at far left, giving a spatial return reference. Ground is pale weathered mineral stone covered with botany and boardwalks, never a bare brown hillside. Northern twilight violet/teal above, warm lamps near reading places, exceptionally magical rich foliage and reflective lighting. Stay immersive and inviting.
